summary: Granny entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Granny
entries.definitive_edition: Steam PC release for capture, with mobile-original state documented if compared

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only for mobile comparison
emulation.notes: Native PC route preferred for capture; real mobile hardware for original touch route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build or original mobile build with exact version/device documented

primary.version: Current Steam PC release, with mobile-original route documented
primary.why: Granny began as a mobile horror game and later received a PC Steam release. The PC route is best for capture and controls, while mobile versions remain the historical baseline and must be labeled if used.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC release for capture. Record build, difficulty, practice mode, escape route, items/randomization, input, graphics/audio settings, and whether Android/iOS or Granny Remake/Escape Together were excluded.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for launch-version and touch-control comparison.
secondary.why: PC is easier to capture, but mobile was the original release context.

all_releases.fidelity: PC route with better capture/control options.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The original mobile route and PC capture route differ in input and update history.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Granny Remake, Granny 2/3, or Granny: Escape Together.
